subject: math
question: 计算积分 $\int \frac{x\ln(x + \sqrt{1 + x^2})}{(1 - x^2)^2}\mathrm{d}x.$
answer: 分析 与上题类似，可将 $\frac{x}{(1 - x^2)^2}$ 凑到微分符号后做分部积分.

steps.text:
分析 与上题类似，可将 $\frac{x}{(1 - x^2)^2}$ 凑到微分符号后做分部积分.

$$
\begin{array}{l} I = \frac {1}{2} \int \ln (x + \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}) d \frac {1}{1 - x ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{2} \ln (x + \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}) \frac {1}{1 - x ^ {2}} - \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {1}{1 - x ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}}} d x \\ \underline {{\underline {{x = \tan t}}}} \frac {\ln (x + \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}})}{2 (1 - x ^ {2})} - \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {1}{1 - \tan^ {2} t} \cdot \frac {1}{\sec t} \cdot \sec^ {2} t d t = \frac {\ln (x + \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}})}{2 (1 - x ^ {2})} - \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {\cos t}{1 - 2 \sin^ {2} t} d t \\ = \frac {\ln (x + \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}})}{2 (1 - x ^ {2})} - \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {2}} \int \frac {d \sqrt {2} \sin t}{1 - 2 \sin^ {2} t} = \frac {\ln (x + \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}})}{2 (1 - x ^ {2})} - \frac {1}{4 \sqrt {2}} \ln \frac {1 + \sqrt {2} \sin t}{1 - \sqrt {2} \sin t} + C \\ = \frac {\ln (x + \sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}})}{2 (1 - x ^ {2})} - \frac {1}{4 \sqrt {2}} \ln \frac {\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}} + \sqrt {2} x}{\sqrt {1 + x ^ {2}} - \sqrt {2} x} + C. \end{array}
$$
分析 与上题类似，可将 $\frac{x}{(1 - x^2)^2}$ 凑到微分符号后做分部积分.
